Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show

Whether you're looking to fill out a sparse tree, add life to a mantelpiece display, or create a themed tablescape, these clip-on robins provide a simple yet effective solution. Their classic design ensures they never go out of style, making them a wonderful addition to any collection of Christmas ornaments.

8941467526448.sourceDescription:
These red velvet ribbon bows are made from soft velvet that feels smooth in the hand and brings a warm, traditional festive feel to a room. The clear red tone sits comfortably alongside green foliage, gold and silver baubles and warm white lights, so the bows read as classic Christmas colour without looking heavy. Velvet has a soft matte surface that catches the light gently rather than shining, which keeps the decoration calm next to tinsel and glitter.

Each bow measures approximately 5 x 10 in (13 x 26 cm) and the ribbon itself is 1 in wide. The generous size makes the bows easy to spot from across a room, whether they are spaced along the branches of a tree or gathered together on a door or wreath, and the wide ribbon gives every bow a full, rounded shape.

The pack contains 12 bows. Tie them onto Christmas trees, wreaths and garlands, or use them on gifts, windows, doors, walls, stair rails and fireplaces. They also work as finishing touches for a party table, a wedding or a picnic, and they suit a home, an office or a shop display.

The classic velvet ribbon shape keeps the decoration simple and elegant rather than busy, so the bows layer happily with baubles, greenery and lights, and they hold their own where space is tight. They make a practical gift for anyone who enjoys crafting and DIY, and they can be used to dress wrapped presents before handing them to family, friends or colleagues.

5075660342048.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

No Drill Fitting
The fitting method does not require drilling for the stated application, making it useful when you want to add an accessory without making new fixing holes.

Textured Grip
The grip surface is designed to reduce unwanted movement in the intended setting. Keeping the contact surfaces clean helps maintain a consistent contact area.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Silicone. Quantity: 12 piece set.
Self-adhesive backing allows for easy, no-drill installation on compatible surfaces.
Features a festive Father Christmas motif to create a recognisable seasonal focal point.
Made from durable silicone with a textured grip to reduce unwanted movement.
Reusable design enables convenient storage and reuse for future holiday occasions.
Comes with 12 x Christmas Wreaths

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Bring festive charm into your home with this 9FT Real-Touch Artificial Pine Garland, designed to look and feel just like fresh pine. At 9 feet long, this garland provides extra coverage compared to standard sizes, making it ideal for decorating mantlepieces, fireplaces, staircases, banisters, doorways, and dining tables. You can display it as a full-length piece or trim it into smaller sections to suit your decorating needs. For a personalised touch, simply add lights, baubles, ribbons, or berries to create your own unique festive style.

Built to last season after season, this garland is waterproof and durable, suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use. Whether in a cosy living room or a covered patio, it retains its fresh appearance without wilting or shedding.

Unlike fresh garlands, this artificial version is eco-friendly and reusable, offering a sustainable and cost-effective way to decorate year after year while reducing waste.

Festive & Timeless – The classic green design pairs perfectly with traditional Christmas ornaments. Add lights, baubles, ribbons or berries to create a warm and welcoming holiday atmosphere throughout your home.
Durable & Weather-Resistant – This garland is waterproof and built to last, suitable for indoor use and sheltered outdoor spaces. Whether in your living room or on a covered patio, it keeps its fresh look all season long.
Lifelike Pine Needle Detailing – Designed with realistic pine needles, this garland brings a cosy, festive feeling wherever it’s placed. Perfect for mantlepieces, fireplaces, tables, or entryways, it’s a must-have decoration for Christmas.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5059442204748.sourceDescription:
Norway Spruce has the unmistakable shape of a traditional Christmas tree, with dark green foliage, a neat conical outline, and branches that angle upwards to create a naturally attractive silhouette. The stiff, pointed needles give it a distinctly spruce-like appearance, while the strong branches provide plenty of support for your favourite decorations. A strong pine fragrance completes the experience, bringing the familiar scent of a real Christmas tree into the home.
STRONG, UPWARD-FACING BRANCHES: The branches of Norway Spruce angle upwards to create its characteristic Christmas-tree shape, while their strength provides good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations. The natural spacing also allows the shape of the tree to remain visible once it is decorated.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH A PINE SCENT: Norway Spruce has the distinctive fragrance associated with traditional spruce trees, adding a natural Christmassy scent to the room that adds to the magic of the season.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: Once the festive period is over, move the tree outdoors where it can continue growing. Its evergreen foliage provides year-round colour, making it suitable for inclusion among evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH ROOM TO DEVELOP: The container provides a practical way to keep the tree growing while it is still young, without committing immediately to a permanent planting position. These live potted Christmas trees can therefore be enjoyed as Christmas trees while also being given the opportunity to become a long-term feature in the garden.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
